# Prijevoz i trgovina Mladen Hošnjak

Official website for the transport and logistics company Prijevoz i trgovina Mladen Hošnjak, based in Croatia.

## Official company identifiers
- Legal name: Prijevoz i trgovina Mladen Hošnjak
- Founded: 2004
- OIB: 11723738409
- UID (VAT): HR11723738409

## Company summary
- Services: domestic and international freight transport (FTL and grouped shipments), refrigerated transport, bulk cargo transport with tipper trailers, high-volume cargo transport, warehousing, and cargo transloading services.
- Fleet: semi-trailer trucks, mega trailers, full-trailer/tandem combinations, refrigerated trailers.
- Team: professional and qualified staff with more than 20 years of operational experience.
- Fleet size: more than 40 freight vehicles.
- Coverage countries: Croatia, Slovenia, Hungary, Austria, Slovakia, Czechia, Germany, Denmark, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Finland, Sweden, Norway.
- Headquarters: Varaždinska ulica 241, 42209 Sračinec, Croatia.

## Trust and quality signals
- More than 20 years of experience in freight transport.
- Professional and qualified workforce.
- Creditworthiness rating: AA+ (CompanyWall).
- Certifications: ISO 9001 and HACCP.
